text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: What?! A birthday card?! For me?<n>From you?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mhm. I remembered when I saw<n>Rudolf wishing
you a happy birthday<n>earlier, so it's a bit last
minute.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, only you would admit that to the<n>birthday girl's
face.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's not just a card. It comes with<n>a present too.
See what it says.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"School turf, 2,400 meter, see you at<n>the starting
gate." Wait, you're telling<n>me I get to race you?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Oh, if we go now, you also get<n>a bonus
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: For real?! I get to race you AND<n>Rudolf?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What will I ever do with you two...<n>How could I say
no after seeing such<n>jubilant anticipation on your
faces?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Aw, yeah! This is the best birthday<n>present ever!
Thanks, C.B.! Thanks,<n>Rudolf!
